r: Tunlon has sent me to ask for some wood for fences.

fallhaven_lumberjack_10.m: Let me see... Oh yes! This is my axe! I cannot thank you enough!
r: So will you cut away those trees that block the old pathway?

fallhaven_lumberjack_11.m: Sure! Already on my way! The work will be finished soon.
r: That sounds great! Remember to ask the stupid guard captain for a decent payment.

fallhaven_lumberjack_12.m: Sure. Will do that. He he.

fallhaven_lumberjack_13.m: You're welcome. But you're not the only one who is happy. There are more people resting for a night in Fallhaven, which helps our economy. Some even bought items at my store! By the way, I was surprised, but I even got paid well by the guard captain.
r: Great. Now everything is much better than it was before!
I wanted to ask about something else.

fallhaven_lumberjack_14.m: Have you made any progress in finding my precious axe?
r: Hello again! I've finally found your axe!
No I haven't. But I'm working on it.
Nope, But I am wondering if you have anything for sale that would help me find your axe?
I cannot thank you enough for cutting away those trees! Finally I've got a shortcut!
What have you got for sale?
Never mind. I don't need your services for now.
Tunlon has sent me to ask for some wood for fences.

fallhaven_lumberjack_16.m: Thank you for bringing me back my axe!
r: So will you cut away those trees that block the old pathway?

fallhaven_lumberjack_17.m: See, I have done a lot of tree cutting lately, and I need a break. Sorry, kid.
r: Oh, alright. But where should I ask then?

fallhaven_lumberjack_18.m: I have heard that a forest to the north was cleared out recently. Sure enough they got some wood laying around there.
r: Thank you very much, I will go there now.

fallhaven_lumberjack_2.m: Yes, I'm Fallhaven's woodcutter. Need anything done in the finest of woods? I have probably got it.
r: I'd like to talk with you about Fallhaven's passage to the Duleian Road.
Never mind. I don't need your services for now.
What have you got for sale?

fallhaven_lumberjack_3.m: Oh no. Not again. I won't start cutting the trees unless I have received a payment beforehand. Go away!
r: Is there anything that would change your mind?
Seems like nobody wants to open the road again. Great.

fallhaven_lumberjack_4.m: Hmm. Well if you would do me a great favor I would start to cut the trees away.

fallhaven_lumberjack_5.m: Let me tell you a story. Long ago, I was cutting in the woods to the north of Fallhaven. I used to cut the trees with great speed with my favorite axe. It was made of fine steel and probably worth more than my hut.

fallhaven_lumberjack_6.m: But then, I got attacked by a pack of wolves and I had to flee immediately. I barely saved my life, but during the escape I lost my precious axe.

fallhaven_lumberjack_7.m: I'm afraid of travelling to that place again because I'm not a trained fighter and the wolves, especially their leader, were really powerful.
r: So I guess you want me to retrieve your axe?

fallhaven_lumberjack_8.m: Yes exactly. If you would do me that favor I will gladly cut away the trees and receive payment afterwards. Just head north to the Crossroads guardhouse and then head eastwards down the Duleian Road. That's where I lost my axe. And look out for that wolf pack!
r: Sounds simple enough. On my way.
No way! That is far too dangerous!

tunlon_fence.10: I found Tunlon, a sheep farmer, on the hill next to Crossglen. He asked me to help him get some wood for new fences. Since Crossglen doesn't have a lumberjack, I should go to Fallhaven and ask there.
tunlon_fence.12: Tunlon got furious when he saw that I killed his sheep.
tunlon_fence.20: I talked to Fallhaven's woodcutter. He told me that he had done a lot of work lately and therefore can't get any more wood for me. However, I should ask the woodcutters near Crossroads Guardhouse if they can help me.
tunlon_fence.30: The woodcutters told me that they have a lot of wood after clearing out the field around them, however all they have is firewood. Apparently this is not suitable for making fences. I should explain this to Tunlon.
tunlon_fence.32: Hadracor opened up a passage to the south, so I wouldn't have to take the long way up to Tunlon any more.
tunlon_fence.40: I talked to Tunlon again and he told me to talk to his brother Tinlyn if he knew any person who could help me out.
tunlon_fence.100: Tinlyn was glad to meet me. He said that Loneford had a woodcutter who could maybe help me out.
tunlon_fence.110: Tinlyn wasn't really happy to see me. However, he told me to go to Loneford.
tunlon_fence.150: In Loneford, I met a villager who told me he had some spare fences made. I should bring them to Tunlon.
tunlon_fence.200: Tunlon took a close look at the fences I brought him, but he didn't like them a lot. The fence posts were too short he said. I should go back and ask for taller ones.
tunlon_fence.210: The woodcutter in Loneford however said he couldn't make any fences, as he just cuts the wood. He recommended giving Brimhaven's woodcutter a visit, as he thinks that he can do some basic woodwork.
tunlon_fence.220: I gave the woodcutter in Brimhaven a visit and he told me to bring some wood, so the craftsman can make fences out of it. Loneford's woodcutter should have plenty, so I should go back and ask him for wood.
tunlon_fence.230: I got a pile of wood for the fences.
tunlon_fence.235: I gave the wood to the woodcraftsman in Brimhaven.
tunlon_fence.240: Brimhaven's wood craftsman sold me some nice looking fences.
tunlon_fence.250: Tunlon was happy to see the fences I brought him. These should be just fine, he said.

pathway_fallhaven: A path to the Duleian Road

pathway_fallhaven.10: I talked to a guard in the east of Fallhaven. He watches over the old passage to the Duleian Road, which is now blocked by fallen trees. If I want to help opening the path I should talk to his superior, the guard captain in the Fallhaven prison.
pathway_fallhaven.20: I talked to the guard captain. I wasn't able to convince him, but he advised me to talk to the woodcutter Jakrar, who lives just south of Fallhaven's prison.
pathway_fallhaven.30: I talked to Jakrar the woodcutter. He will only clear the trees away if I do him a favor. I should search for his favorite axe east of the Crossroads Guardhouse, located to the north of Fallhaven. I should keep my eyes open for an evil wolf pack.
pathway_fallhaven.40: I showed Jakrar the axe I found and he recognized it immediately.
pathway_fallhaven.50: Jakrar was very happy to see his good old axe again. He expressed his gratitude, and started to clear away the trees immediately.
pathway_fallhaven.60: Now the woodcutter has cleared away all the trees that blocked the path. Finally, the townsfolk have got back their shortcut to the Duleian Road!

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
